subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Hit the nail on the head

options.text: say something that is exactly right
say or do something that is painful
hit someone hard on the head

solution:
The correct answer is: **say something that is exactly right**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The idiom '**Hit the nail on the head**' is an expression used to be exactly right about something.

 
 
• Example- *Duncan Smith **hit the nail on the head__** when he said that the Prime Minister promised so much and yet changed so little.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **'Hit the nail on the head'** is to 'say something that is exactly right'

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.
